selection.rule: First two chronological manufacturer-1 reports with problem 'no heat' or 'not enough heat', outside substations 21, 4, and 7 and on distinct substations, having >=100 prior-24-hour samples and nonempty required hc1 fields; choice of reports 3 and 13 frozen before second comparison.
selection.cutoff: measurement timestamp <= report date; prior records strictly earlier

event_description: Insufficient heat in the building system; heating circuit 1 shows no cooling and control limits primary side return temperature, probably short circuit in the connected object. Heating circuit 2 is not receiving sufficient volume flow. The pump output has therefore been increased.
fault_label: Failure of the heating circuit pump
note: Published report fields are retrospective; they are not a real-time ground truth at the decision time.
